supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed domain logons for svc-render are recorded from 13:31 through 13:46 UTC. The FILE-NWD-01 events report bad-password status 0xc000006a and identify FILE-NWD-01 as the workstation.

The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals and show the same FILE-NWD-01 process ID and LSASS process name, which is consistent with the documented svc-render job that runs and re-authenticates every minute. The change calendar also schedules a svc-render password rotation at 13:30 UTC, before the observed failures.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed authentication for svc-render from FILE-NWD-01: 4776 events report bad-password status 0xc000006a, and 4771 events report status 0x18.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover only 13:31:03 through 13:46:04 UTC, not the full requested 13:20–14:20 window; the first and last supplied records are T032-00001 and T032-00033.
The supplied records show failed authentications only; they do not establish whether any successful svc-render logon occurred elsewhere in the alert window.
The records do not identify the RenderQueue configuration or confirm when its stored password was updated.
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled password rotation completed at 13:30 UTC and whether the RenderQueue job was updated afterward.
Whether there were successful or additional failed svc-render authentications during the portions of the alert window not represented by the supplied records.
Whether the observed attempts were exclusively generated by the legitimate RenderQueue job, rather than another process or actor on FILE-NWD-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Authentication logs for the complete 13:20–14:20 UTC window from FILE-NWD-01 and DC-NWD-01, including successful and failed logons.
The password-rotation change record and evidence of when the RenderQueue job's stored credential was updated.
RenderQueue scheduler and application logs for the window, plus process or service attribution for the repeated authentication attempts.
